value.summary: This pull request changes a single import line from `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh;` to `use openhuman_core as oh;`.  The change is syntactically and semantically sound — it uses the crate root alias instead of re-importing a submodule with the same name, and no other code in this file references `oh` differently.  It introduces no security issues, no untrusted input handling changes, no new network or subprocess calls, no deserialization of untrusted data, no path traversal, no secrets exposure, no dependency changes, and no CI permission changes.  The change looks safe to merge.
